scope: Exact current-source R9700 HIP / ROCm and Vulkan archives, including model lifecycle and actual client checks.
Seven Vulkan inference models and six HIP models; the 0.6B Vulkan starter is not in the recommended coding cohort.
Client contexts are 16,384 tokens, except Gemma 4 31B at 8,192; this does not extend larger-context quality or qualify Intel or Metal.
No performance comparison or release publication is claimed.

installation.scope: Exact candidate archives mirrored locally; isolated upgrade/rollback/version controls only, no model loading.

summary.scope: Six recommended coding models, two AMD backends, exact archives and frozen helpers. Does not certify Intel.

independent_review.scope: Longer development soak, glibc 2.39; final archived binaries still require qualification

prior_records.scope: Earlier immutable AMD snapshot; retains the first Gemma 31B delivery failure, matched helper follow-ups, prior trace inefficiencies and the separate 27B / 64K browser capacity check.
